Rehabilitation and Settlement Act, 2013 to the authority concerned, by considering the petitioner's representation dated 04.03.2024.

sentences.text: However, the same is pending without consideration till date.

3. The learned Additional Government Pleader submitted that as the respondents 4 and 5 had set up rival claims, the matter will be referred to the appropriate authority as per law within a period stipulated by this Court.
4. Heard both sides and perused the materials available on record.
Since no adverse order is passed against the respondents 4 and 5, notice to them are dispensed with.
By consent of both parties, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

5. Such view of the matter, this Court without going into the merits of the case, directs the first R.Singaravelan vs The District Collector on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102704498/
